name: AI Employee Common Workflow Templates
description: Standardized automation templates for AI Employee platform. Compatible with n8n and AI Employee orchestrator.

templates.name: Appointment Lifecycle & Follow-up Sequence
templates.description: Multi-channel sequence: Instant WhatsApp confirmation, email receipt, 24h reminder, and post-visit 5-star review request.

nodes.name: Webhook - Appointment Created
nodes.notes: Receives the {tenantId, businessId, customerId, conversationId, eventType, data} envelope sent when an appointment is booked.

nodes.name: Extract Booking Details
nodes.notes: Extracts client name, phone, email, service, time, and appointment ID.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Confirmation
nodes.notes: Sends instant WhatsApp booking confirmation to the customer.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $json.clientName + "! 👋 Your appointment for " + $json.service + " is confirmed for " + $json.localTime + ". We look forward to seeing you at Acme Salon! Reply anytime if you need to make changes.", "tenantId": $json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Send Email Receipt
nodes.notes: Dispatches an email receipt if customer provided an email address.

nodes.name: Wait 24 Hours
nodes.notes: Waits 24 hours before sending the upcoming appointment reminder.

nodes.name: Check Appointment Status
nodes.notes: Queries GlowDesk integration to check if the appointment is still active.

nodes.name: Is Still Confirmed?
nodes.notes: Verifies appointment status is not cancelled before sending reminder.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Reminder
nodes.notes: Sends interactive 24h reminder with confirmation/reschedule options.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.clientName + " 👋 Just a reminder that you have your " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.service + " appointment tomorrow at " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.localTime + ". Reply 1 to confirm or 2 to reschedule.", "tenantId": $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait Until Post-Appointment
nodes.notes: Waits until appointment has concluded.

nodes.name: Check Final Status
nodes.notes: Checks if appointment was marked completed.

nodes.name: Is Visit Completed?
nodes.notes: Branches on completed vs cancelled.

nodes.name: Ask For Review (WhatsApp)
nodes.notes: Sends post-appointment feedback and review request.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.clientName + "! 🌟 Thank you for visiting Acme Salon today! How was your " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.service + "? We would love your feedback: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐", "tenantId": $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Update CRM Notes
nodes.notes: Logs completion and feedback survey sent in client CRM profile.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "action": "update_client_crm", "data": { "clientId": $('Check Final Status').item.json.data?.client?.id || $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.customerId, "notes": "Completed appointment " + $('Extract Booking Details').item.json.service + ". Post-visit review request sent." } } }}

nodes.name: Stop Workflow (Cancelled)
nodes.notes: Logs cancellation and gracefully stops.

templates.name: Scheduled Appointment Reminders (24h & 2h)
templates.description: Timed notifications 24 hours and 2 hours prior to scheduled appointment with 1-click confirmation or reschedule prompts.

nodes.name: Webhook - Appointment Created
nodes.notes: Triggers on appointment.created event to schedule multi-tier reminders.

nodes.name: Parse Timing & Customer
nodes.notes: Extracts start time and phone number.

nodes.name: Wait Until 24h Before
nodes.notes: Waits until 24h before appointment time.

nodes.name: Check 24h Status
nodes.notes: Ensures booking is still active.

nodes.name: Send 24h WhatsApp Reminder
nodes.notes: Sends reminder with confirm / reschedule options.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.clientName + " 👋 Reminder: You have your " + $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.service + " appointment tomorrow at " + $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.localTime + ".\n\nReply 1 to confirm or 2 to reschedule.", "tenantId": $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait Until 2h Before
nodes.notes: Waits until 2 hours before the appointment.

nodes.name: Send 2h Quick Reminder
nodes.notes: Sends arrival and directions reminder 2 hours before slot.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.clientName + "! ⏰ See you in 2 hours for your " + $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.service + " at Acme Salon. We have prepared your station!", "tenantId": $('Parse Timing & Customer').item.json.tenantId } }}

templates.name: New Customer Lead Follow-up Sequence
templates.description: Automated nurture sequence: Instant welcome + pricing on Day 0, gentle follow-up on Day 1, special offer on Day 3, and sales alert on Day 7.

nodes.name: Webhook - New Lead Inquiry
nodes.notes: Receives customer.created / lead inquiry event.

nodes.name: Extract Customer Info
nodes.notes: Extracts customer details.

nodes.name: Send Day 0 Welcome & Pricing
nodes.notes: Sends instant welcome message.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $json.customerName + "! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to Acme Salon. Our haircut services start from Rs. 4,500 and coloring from Rs. 12,000. Would you like me to check available appointment slots for you?", "tenantId": $json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait 1 Day
nodes.notes: Waits 1 day before first follow-up.

nodes.name: Check Day 1 Booking Status
nodes.notes: Checks if lead has booked an appointment.

nodes.name: Did Customer Book (Day 1)?
nodes.notes: Stops sequence if customer already booked.

nodes.name: Send Day 1 Follow-up
nodes.notes: Sends polite Day 1 follow-up message.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerName + "! Just checking in 😊 Would you like me to find an available time for your salon appointment this week?", "tenantId": $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait 2 Days
nodes.notes: Waits 2 days before second follow-up.

nodes.name: Check Day 3 Booking Status
nodes.notes: Checks if lead booked after 1st follow-up.

nodes.name: Did Customer Book (Day 3)?
nodes.notes: Stops if booked.

nodes.name: Send Day 3 Availability Offer
nodes.notes: Sends urgency/availability offer.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerName + ", we have some prime slots open this weekend! Would you like me to hold a time for you?", "tenantId": $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait 3 Days
nodes.notes: Waits 3 days before escalating unconverted lead.

nodes.name: Notify Staff / Sales (Slack)
nodes.notes: Alerts human team to follow up manually with unconverted lead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "text": "🔔 Unconverted Lead Alert: " + $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerName + " (" + $('Extract Customer Info').item.json.customerPhone + ") has not booked after automated follow-up sequence. Manual contact recommended." } }}

nodes.name: Stop - Lead Booked ✅
nodes.notes: Terminates sequence when booking detected.

templates.name: Customer Retention & 30-Day Rebooking
templates.description: Post-visit customer retention flow: review request 24h after visit, followed by a personalized recurring rebooking prompt after 30 days.

nodes.name: Webhook - Appointment Completed
nodes.notes: Triggers when an appointment is completed.

nodes.name: Extract Completion Info
nodes.notes: Extracts customer & service data.

nodes.name: Wait 1 Day
nodes.notes: Waits 1 day after appointment.

nodes.name: Send Thank You & Review Request
nodes.notes: Requests feedback & review on WhatsApp.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $json.clientName + "! 🌟 Thank you for visiting Acme Salon yesterday. We hope you loved your " + $json.service + "! Could you take a moment to leave us a quick review? ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐", "tenantId": $json.tenantId } }}

nodes.name: Wait 29 Days (30 Days Total)
nodes.notes: Waits until 30 days post-appointment.

nodes.name: Send 30-Day Rebooking Reminder
nodes.notes: Encourages recurring salon visit.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "recipient": $('Extract Completion Info').item.json.customerPhone, "content": "Hi " + $('Extract Completion Info').item.json.clientName + "! 👋 It's been about a month since your last " + $('Extract Completion Info').item.json.service + ". Ready for a fresh look? Reply anytime and I will find the best available slot for you this week!", "tenantId": $('Extract Completion Info').item.json.tenantId } }}

templates.name: CRM Lead Sync & Slack Notification
templates.description: Instant event bridge: checks external CRM for existing customer record, creates lead profile, and notifies team on Slack.

nodes.name: Webhook - AI Employee Event
nodes.notes: Receives the {tenantId, businessId, customerId, conversationId, eventType, data} envelope sent by N8nService.triggerWorkflow(). Wire Workflow.triggerEventType (e.g. "customer.created") to this workflow's n8nWorkflowId via POST /workflows.

nodes.name: Check CRM For Existing Lead
nodes.notes: Simulates looking the customer up in an external CRM before creating a duplicate lead.

nodes.name: Create Lead Record
nodes.notes: Simulates creating a new lead record from the event payload (in a real workflow this would branch on the CRM lookup result via an IF node first).

assignments.name: leadId
assignments.value: ={{ $json.id || ($('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json.body || $('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json).customerId }}

assignments.name: tenantId
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json.body || $('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json).tenantId }}

assignments.name: customerId
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json.body || $('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json).customerId }}

assignments.name: conversationId
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json.body || $('Webhook - AI Employee Event').item.json).conversationId }}

nodes.name: Notify Sales (Slack)
nodes.notes: Simulates posting a new-lead notification to a Slack (or email) webhook.

meta.description: Scaffold example workflow: reacts to an AI Employee event (e.g. customer.created) via Workflow.triggerEventType, checks an external CRM for an existing lead, creates one if missing, and notifies sales. Not a production-ready import — a reasonable approximation of n8n's export shape for scaffold purposes.
